vocab.definition: uses fuel + oxygen to produce a voltage continuously.
reacts hydrogen with oxygen to make water.
hydrogen loses electrons at the electrode.

misconceptions.right: They run as long as fuel is supplied.
A hydrogen fuel cell only makes water.
Hydrogen is hard and costly to store safely.

infoPanels.title: OVERALL REACTION
workedSteps: Hydrogen is oxidised at the negative electrode.
Oxygen is reduced at the positive electrode.
